title: Business Development Associate in Ahmedabad, Meerut, Bangalore
Sales Executive - Diagnostics
description:
**The Opportunity**
**The Opportunity: \-**
 Looking for a fresher with a zeal to find new business by prospecting, qualifying and generating new marketing and competitor analysis. Should have liking for techno commercial marketing role – a professional who will be accountable and responsible for marketing and sales operations of Diagnostics Business.
   

  

 Works independently under close supervision, responsible for selling to new channel partners/distributors and cross/up/repeat sales to existing channel partners/distributors. Maintain existing relationships with organizations distributing products, services and/or solutions. Deliver product demonstrations, sales bids and presentations to channel partners/distributors. Manage the relationship with the channel partners/distributors.
   

  

**What we’re looking for: \-**
 Education: Science graduate or a similar field, MBA Preferred
   

  

 Experience: 0\-1 years’ experience in the Sales of the Diagnostics range of products.
   

  

**How you will thrive and create an impact: \-**
* Analyze past project / business data to create new insights for value proposition, improving customer\-experience, identifying new business opportunities etc.
* Process all generated leads from website or email
* Qualify all leads before presenting them to Management
* Conducting detailed and regular market research to discover new customers and stay up to date with the competitive landscape
* Maintaining updated knowledge of company products and services
* Maintaining an accurate and updated database of customer information
* Regularly communicating with the prospects and customers to understand their needs
* Presenting and demonstrating the value of our products and services to prospects and existing customers
* Handling the documentation during the customer lifecycle
* Developing and managing an efficient Customer Support System
* Building long\-lasting, mutually beneficial relationships with dealers, customers based on trust and respect to create a better customer experience.
* Identify right set of customers, promote the products and achieve sales goals for the given territory for Avantor Diagnostic
* Develop new business within assigned geographic territory \& clients by doing market survey on the potential of products and competitions’ market share
* Identify new key accounts, distributor/channel partners and direct trade opportunities
* Implement business strategies successfully to grow profitable sales.
* Key Account Management \& working closely with Channel Distributors to achieve Sales and profitability Targets
* Follows up diligently on leads received from other areas of the organization.
* Responsible for preparation of Sales Forecasts
* Functions as a segment expert; understands market issues \& trends impacting the designated segment of the market
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing pre\-sales, after\-sales support, product education and advice. Ensuring timely delivery of products
